user.title: Select carrier
user.description: Each account is one config entry; add the integration again for more numbers.

telecom.title: China Telecom
telecom.description: Sign in with the Telecom service password (the query password of the web/app portal).

unicom.title: China Unicom
unicom.description: Sign in with the Unicom service password.

unicom_openid.title: China Unicom (openid)
unicom_openid.description: Paste the openid captured from the Unicom WeChat mini program. Leave the phone empty to auto-detect.

mobile_sms.title: China Mobile (SMS)
mobile_sms.description: Enter the phone number; a verification code will be sent on submit.

mobile_sms_code.title: China Mobile (SMS)
mobile_sms_code.description: If no code arrived automatically: open the China Mobile app login page (or wx.10086.cn if available), request the code there, then enter it below. China Mobile blocks server-side SMS sending.

mobile_password.title: China Mobile (password)
mobile_password.description: Sign in with the China Mobile service password.

mobile_cookie.title: China Mobile (Cookie)
mobile_cookie.description: Log in to wx.10086.cn in a browser and paste the Cookie header.

broadnet.title: China Broadnet
broadnet.description: Log in at {url} in a browser, then copy the qryUserRes request as cURL and paste it below.

data.cookies: Cookie (leave empty if included in cURL)

telecom_sms_phone.title: China Telecom (SMS)
telecom_sms_phone.description: Submit the phone number; the slider CAPTCHA is solved automatically and an SMS code is sent.

unicom_sms.title: China Unicom (SMS)
unicom_sms.description: An SMS code is requested on submit. If the server requires a slider CAPTCHA, open {url} on your phone, or paste the resultToken below.

unicom_cookie.title: China Unicom (Cookie)
unicom_cookie.description: Log in at m.client.10010.com/login-web in a desktop browser, then copy the Cookie request header from DevTools and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the carrier server
error.telecom_need_captcha: CAPTCHA required, retry later or set a trusted device ID
error.telecom_device_untrusted: Device not trusted; sign in via the official app once or set a trusted device ID
error.telecom_account_locked: Account locked, unlock via official channels
error.telecom_password_locked: Service password locked, reset via official channels
error.telecom_invalid_credentials: Wrong phone number or service password（{reason}） ({reason})
error.unicom_invalid_credentials: Wrong phone number or service password
error.mobile_captcha_required: Risk-control CAPTCHA triggered, retry later or use password login
error.mobile_account_locked: Account locked, unlock via official channels
error.mobile_password_error: Wrong phone number or service password
error.mobile_sms_send_failed: Failed to send the SMS code, retry later or use another method
error.mobile_session_expired: Login session expired, please sign in again
error.broadnet_import_invalid: Could not parse the paste; expected cURL or a full URL
error.broadnet_session_expired: Broadnet session expired, log in again and copy a fresh request
error.broadnet_query_failed: Broadnet query failed, verify the session and retry
error.telecom_sms_send_failed: Failed to send the SMS code; try password login instead
error.telecom_session_expired: Session expired, please sign in again
error.unicom_sms_send_failed: Failed to send the SMS code: {reason}
error.unicom_forced_sms: This account is forced to SMS-code login by China Unicom. Use the SMS login method instead: open m.client.10010.com/login-web on your phone, complete the slider, then enter the received code.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Leave empty to refresh all accounts.
